snapshot.title: GM: Restart Operations Authorization

transcript.speaker: General Manager
transcript.text: This is the General Manager. I’ve reviewed the evidence and the restart criteria. I am authorizing a restart of operations at 14:30, per the Campaign Plan (FOM-101, Annex B). All conditions are met: no data was compromised, no client data was exposed, and UAS-12 is not damaged. Confirm that the fleet register is up to date and that the pre-flight checklist for the next campaign is cleared.

transcript.speaker: Incident Commander
transcript.text: Confirmed, General Manager. The fleet register (FOM-101) reflects UAS-12 as undamaged and no data compromise was detected. The Campaign Plan (FOM-101, Annex B) has been reviewed and the restart criteria are satisfied. Operations will resume at 14:30.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the restart authorization. The IC must verify the fleet register and campaign plan before acknowledging. The group is now returning to normal operations.
